# JEFIT

> > JEFIT is a comprehensive workout planner and tracking app with 20M+ downloads, featuring exercise databases, customizable routines, progressive overload tracking, and Elite subscription features like BodyMap and Load Progression Engine.

JEFIT provides strength training and bodybuilding tools for iOS and Android users, with features highlighted by Men's Health, PC Magazine, and USA TODAY. The platform includes JefitTeam-curated programs, Personal Coach Mode for trainers, and community-driven workout routines.

## Key Topics

- Progressive Overload
- Load Progression Engine
- Jefit Elite
- BodyMap
- Iron Points
- JefitTeam
- 5x5 training
- 5/3/1 programming
- Upper-lower split
- Push-pull-legs (PPL)
- 1RM tracking
- Exercise logging
- Workout metrics
- Personal Coach Mode
- Year in Review 2025

## Core Platform

- [Your Ultimate Workout Planner & Tracking App for Progress - JEFIT](https://jefit.com): Homepage for JEFIT workout planner with 20M+ downloads, featured by Men's Health
- [App Download - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/download): Download page for JEFIT iOS and Android apps
- [Fitness app - JEFIT](https://cdn.jefit.com/download/fitness-app): Custom workout builder with drag-and-drop interface and exercise library
- [Weight Lifting - JEFIT](https://cdn.jefit.com/download/weight-lifting): Strength training app with customizable programs and advanced analytics
- [Your Ultimate Workout Planner & Tracking App for Progress - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/use-case/strength-training-app): Strength training app for tracking 1RM, progressive overload, and 5x5/5/3/1

## Workout Routines & Programs

- [Workout Routine Database - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/routines): Searchable database of workout routines for beginners to advanced lifters
- [Jefit Sample Beginner Routine - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/routines/1088151/jefit-sample-beginner-routine): 4-day intermediate bulking routine for chest, shoulders, back, arms, and legs
- [5x5 Strength Training Plan for Beginners - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/routines/506397/5x5-strength-training-plan-for-beginners): 4-day beginner barbell 5x5 strength program by JefitTeam with upper/lower split
- [3/7 Strength Training Method - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/routines/602005/37-strength-training-method): 3-day beginner machine-based bulking program using 3/7 Method by JefitTeam

## Exercise Library

- [Exercise Database - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/exercises): Searchable exercise library filtered by muscle group and equipment type
- [Stability Ball Crunch - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/exercises/60/stability-ball-crunch): Beginner abs exercise using stability ball with step-by-step instructions

- [Rowing - JEFIT](https://jefit.com/exercises/316/rowing): Rowing cardio exercise with alternative full-body workout options
